verification.note: GitHub Actions run 31639127073 is green for the v1.16.1 targeted contracts and full maintained regression suite. GitHub Import is now reachable from a hidden system-owner-only tools screen while ordinary owners and administrators keep the original system diagnostics and receive no GitHub Import entry. An emergency /github_import command is also silent for every non-system-owner account. Network failures in owner GitHub callbacks are rendered back into the bot instead of leaving the Telegram spinner active. Retry Failed retries only the exact failed version+commit; newer source revisions require a fresh manual diff/confirmation. GitHub import reuses task-local discovery, validates callback-safe manifests, avoids per-file Contents API calls for public packages, reserves disk for the temporary ZIP, and reports explicit rate-limit failures. VK first-publication failures are retryable without back-posting historical books. Live account-dependent checks still require deployment; no production books are fabricated by QA.

name: GitHub import and cross-platform release hardening
